page.layout: One page of text, with marginal notes in the right margin. Running head and page number at the top. Heading block at top: "Exercitatio XIX.", then "Epistola Responsoria.", then the italic statement of the question. Body in paragraphs with a lettered "Ratio" list and numbered theses. Catchword and signature at the foot.

main_text.head: Exercitatio XIX.
Epistola Responsoria.
main_text.p: De quaestione: Cur Spiritus sanctus non mox à resurrectione Christi, sed demum die Pentecostes Apostolis missus fuerit.
Ratio 1. quia videas, cum cum Ecclesia tem-pore consueto de praecipuis Dei beneficiis cogi-tare.
II. quia tibi occasionem dederit de Quaestio-ne accuratius cogitandi.

Occupat.per adversat: Etsi citra jacturam salu-tis causae ignorari possint: & praestet fructus mis-sionis Spiritus sancti meditari, quam momentaAct.1.[?] temporis investigare: tamen tibi etiam videri quaestionem explicatione non indignam.
Ratio 1. quia ad illustrationem beneficii Ec-clesiae exhibiti pertineat.
II. Quia etiam veteres Theologi eam tracta-Augustin. Chrysost.rint.
I. Cur non illico à resurrectione Christi.
II. Cur die Pentecostes venerit Spiritus sanctus..
Ἐξήγησις[?] prima partis sit causarum enumeratio.
I. Quia post Christi ascensionem demum promissus fuerat, Ioh.16.
II. Quia Christo praesente discipuli nondum opus co habebant.

page.notes: Right-margin note "Act.1." is partly unclear; the first letters read as "Aƒ", so I have marked it [?]. The page number "339" is hard to read at the top right; the last digit is uncertain. The Greek word "Ἐξήγησις" is uncertain in its letters and is marked [?]. "co" in "opus co habebant" may be a printing error for "eo"; it is copied as printed. The "I." numbering of the list items and the "1." of the Ratio items are read from the scan and may vary slightly. The signature "I iiij." and catchword "Ratio" are at the foot; the catchword is set at a slant.
